run_generated_tasks_test: run the unittest test suite to verify generated task checksums match stored hashes
test_task_checksum_matches: test that computed task hashes for each template match the stored checksum JSON file
load_compiled_template_dict: load all compiled PHYRE task templates into a dictionary keyed by template id

review_generated_task_checksums: review the PHYRE generated tasks test to understand how task integrity is verified
